Exact graph operators with symcompR

Source: R/integrations.R
graph_operator_symbolic.Rd

Returns a graph operator as an exact symbolic matrix from symcompR: the adjacency matrix, the Laplacian \(D - A\), or the GCN propagation matrix \(\hat D^{-1/2} (A + I) \hat D^{-1/2}\) used by gcn_conv(), with square roots kept exact. Row \(i\), column \(j\) is the weight from \(j\) to \(i\). Edge weights are ignored (unweighted operators), so every entry is an integer, a rational or an algebraic number.

Usage

graph_operator_symbolic(g, operator = c("adjacency", "laplacian", "gcn"))

Arguments

g

A graph_data object.

operator

"adjacency", "laplacian" or "gcn".

Value

A symcompR matrix; as.matrix() gives its numeric value.

Details

This is an optional bridge, useful for checking layer normalizations against exact values or showing the operator a layer applies. It needs symcompR and is meant for small graphs.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("symcompR", quietly = TRUE)) {
  g <- graph_data(edge_index = rbind(1:2, 2:3), num_nodes = 3, directed = FALSE)
  graph_operator_symbolic(g, "gcn")
}
#> Matrix(3, 3)
#> [1/2      , sqrt(6)/6, 0        ]
#> [sqrt(6)/6, 1/3      , sqrt(6)/6]
#> [0        , sqrt(6)/6, 1/2      ]
